Package models

Class GuestExperience

java.lang.Object
models.GuestExperience
public class GuestExperience extends Object
Represents an experience offering available at a specific hotel in the MIRAGE system.

A GuestExperience is a bookable activity or service tied to a particular hotel (e.g. a spa session, private dining, or a city tour). Each experience has a base cost that serves as a reference price; the actual cost charged to a reservation may differ and is stored in ReservationExperience.getActualCost().

Experiences are scoped to a hotel — only experiences belonging to the same hotel as the reservation can be booked for that reservation. This constraint is enforced by ExperienceDAO.insertExperience().

Database mapping: guest_experience table.

  • Constructor Details

    • GuestExperience

      public GuestExperience(int hotelId, String experienceName, String description, double baseCost)
      Creates a new GuestExperience for a specific hotel. experienceId is left at 0 until the record is persisted and the key is set via setExperienceId(int).
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel offering this experience; must be positive
      experienceName - the display name of the experience; must not be null or blank
      description - a detailed description; may be empty or null
      baseCost - the reference price in USD; must be non-negative
